title: More About Me
intro: Data scientist, teacher and community organiser. I turn messy data into decisions people trust, and I share what I learn.
bio: I'm {role} at {company}, where I set the data and AI strategy and build what it needs.

In {years}+ years across travel, banking, finance and e-commerce, I've shipped everything from BI and data pipelines to machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI. I own the whole path: the problem, the architecture and the build.
M.Tech from BITS Pilani, where I now teach as Guest Faculty. Certified in {certifications}.
Tableau Ambassador in 2025 and 2026. I lead {communities} data and AI communities across Tableau, AWS, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks and IBM.
My rule: understand the problem deeply, build the right solution, keep the engineering simple.
